4 اطفلت , said of a woman, (S, O, TA,) and of a girl, or young woman, (صبية, [but this, I doubt not, is a mistranscription for ظَبْيَة, i. e. a doe-gazelle,]) and of a she-camel, (TA,) or of any female, (Msb,) She had a طِفْل [or young one of tender age]: (S, O, TA:) or she brought forth. (Msb.) ―
-b2- See also 1, in two places. ＝
-A2- And see 2.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
